title: Subtract a value from a two-term product
rationale: Order-total and invoice arithmetic errors propagate silently into billing and inventory decisions, so a model that botches a basic product-minus-difference calculation cannot be trusted with numeric work.

prompt.content: You are a precise arithmetic assistant. Answer with the number only.

notes: Expected value 272, verified with Python: 17 * 23 = 391; 391 - 119 = 272. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, single number-only answer. Brittleness: a chatty reply whose first number is not the result fails even if the result appears later; the system message forbids explanation to keep the first number authoritative.
